item: T5 layout PR (R131): the repeat_agreed marker and the twice-read languages in the stoplist tool, the empty-ring caveat as a translated template

summary: The coordinator's marker brief: the triage converter writes repeat_agreed on an N row whose blind repeat also called it N at high confidence under a code that is not gn or lv (6580 of the 6623 rows the gate accepts; the other 43 were repeated under gn or lv); stopword_batch.py accepts the flag beside single_reader without letting it unblock anything and admits a word of a TWICE_READ language (vi ko as tl) only with the marker or a hand review file, refusing it as not_twice_read; each batch comment records the counts and which rule let a twice-read word in; the converter's check-tool runs the tool's own gate over every flag subset for each twice-read language. Retroactive check over what shipped before the marker: Korean 26 words, one out (참석했다, first a phrase fragment then an everyday verb); Tagalog 37 words, none out (reported, not removed). The 'all hidden' ring caveat now travels as a fixed template plus its values and is keyed in all twelve locales and shown in the ring map's empty state. The brief is kept in docs/plans/2026-10-13-t5-layout-pr/PLAN.md.
